ErrorDetail.description:
The `detail` object inside an *application* error response.

`error` is a stable, snake_case machine code; the set raised by the surface is
`not_found`, `invalid_request`, `internal_error`, `queue_full`,
`resource_locked`, `unauthorized`, `forbidden`, `token_budget_exceeded`,
`not_ready`, `payload_too_large`, `idempotency_key_in_progress`,
`idempotency_key_conflict`, and `invalid_idempotency_key` (treat the list as
illustrative, not exhaustive — new snake_case codes may be added in a minor).
`message` is a human-readable string. Some errors carry extra context keys
(e.g. `resource`, `queue_depth`, `limit`, `required_scope`, `scope`,
`metadata`, `max_body_bytes`), so additional fields are permitted.

**Exception:** request-*validation* failures (unknown fields, type/shape
errors, and the size-limit checks) return FastAPI's native `422` with a
list-shaped `detail` (`{"detail": [{"loc": ..., "msg": ..., "type": ...}]}`),
**not** this `{error, message}` envelope. Application/runtime errors use this
envelope; framework request-validation uses the native 422 shape.
ErrorDetail.title: ErrorDetail

ErrorResponse.description:
Error envelope returned for every 4xx/5xx response.

The wire shape is always `{"detail": {...}}` — FastAPI nests the error
payload under `detail`. Published in the OpenAPI schema so codegen clients
can model errors uniformly.
ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse

SkillsListResponse.description: GET /v1/skills response body (read-only skill catalog: name/description/path).
SkillsListResponse.title: SkillsListResponse

SkillsOverlay.description:
Per-request skill toggle for a run: enable / disable the root agent's skills.

`add` enables skills that must already be **declared** in the spec's `skills`
block (no arbitrary injection from a request); `disable` removes skills from
the root agent's selection.
SkillsOverlay.title: SkillsOverlay

SpecExplainRequest.description:
POST /v1/specs/explain request body.

Subclasses `SpecValidateRequest` like compile / policy-report do —
for the shared envelope AND its size validators. The hand-copied
variant gained `environment`/`overlays`/`overrides` for envelope
parity but omitted the overlays/overrides size caps every sibling
enforces.
SpecExplainRequest.title: SpecExplainRequest

SpecValidateRequest.description: POST /v1/specs/validate request body (also reused for compile / policy-report).
SpecValidateRequest.title: SpecValidateRequest
